capability_declaration.evidence: IEC 61850-7-4 (Logical Nodes) and IEC 61850-6 (Configuration description language - SCL)
capability_declaration.rationale: IEC 61850 explicitly defines standardized logical nodes and data models for DER capabilities, enabling devices to declare their functionalities.

bounded_authority.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 (Services), IEC 61850-8-1 (MMS), and IEC 61850-90-7 (DER-specific control functions)
bounded_authority.rationale: The standard partially covers authority limits via control modes and access control, but lacks explicit revocation/expiry mechanisms.

decision_auditability.evidence: IEC 61850-7-2 (Logging and reporting services) and IEC 61850-8-1 (MMS logging)
decision_auditability.rationale: IEC 61850 supports logging of events and decisions, but attribution to specific agents is not fully explicit.

data_governance.evidence: IEC 61850-6 (SCL for data modeling) and general cybersecurity clauses in IEC 61850-8-1
data_governance.rationale: Data governance is implicitly covered via modeling and security, but lacks explicit requirements for ownership, consent, or retention.
